readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. protein: SpCas9 (Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9, RNA-guided DNA endonuclease), human codon optimised
readout: Enrichment under positive (on-target) selection, which kills cells whose SpCas9 fails to cleave the ccdB target; higher is more active
assay_method: Deep mutational scanning of a 1.9e7-member SpCas9 variant library in Escherichia coli using a two-plasmid ccdB selection system that separates active from inactive nuclease. Positive (on-target) and negative (off-target) selections were performed, cells sorted by flow cytometry on a BD FACSAria, and variant abundance read out by 2x150-bp paired-end Illumina NextSeq sequencing. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: The assayed construct is UniProt Q99ZW2 at positions 1-1368 followed by a 22-residue C-terminal tag, SRADPKKKRKVCTYPYDVPDYA, carrying an SV40 nuclear localisation signal and an HA epitope; the tag is part of the molecule that was assayed and 53 of these variants fall inside it. 1 row(s) are dropped for naming a terminator rather than an amino acid, including a readthrough of the stop at position 1391. There is no wild-type row in the deposit, so wt_readout is empty and the zero point of normalized-score is the dataset mean. 65 rows collapse into 63 duplicate groups, worst spread 3.1205.
